stories.headline: Apple Set to Accelerate Wallet War With Automated Bill Splitting
stories.body: An upcoming iPhone feature will enable users to split bills by photographing a receipt, assigning items to different people, and then generating payments requests, Bloomberg reported Monday (June 1), citing unnamed sources.
